name: Chol'aruk the Ravener

angles.text: The orc Gur'ak issues this call to arms under the traditional Horde battle cry 'Blood and thunder,' tasking adventurers with cutting down a dangerous menace lurking in the Barrens.
Tracking down a monstrous beast rumored to be five times larger than normal quilboar demands a hunter's keen instincts and preparation for formidable prey.
Facing a brutal creature known for an insatiable bloodthirst requires frontline warriors ready to brace against overwhelming physical fury.

faq.answer: Chol'aruk, also called The Ravener by the Razormane tribe, is a legendary and monstrous quilboar. Rumored to be five times the size of standard quilboar, it possesses an insatiable thirst for blood and lairs within a deep cave in the Barrens.
Chol'aruk dwells deep within a cave at Thorn Hill, situated northeast of Gur'ak's encampment in the Barrens. Adventurers must venture into Thorn Hill's caverns to find its lair.

Gur'ak, an orc stationed in the Barrens, offers the task. Unlike others who dismiss stories of the giant beast as mere tavern talk, Gur'ak believes the rumors because he has faced similar monstrosities before.
faq.q: Who offers the hunt for Chol'aruk?

faq.answer: Gur'ak wants Chol'aruk destroyed to eliminate a savage threat terrorizing the region and demands the beast's severed head as proof that the Ravener has fallen.

Gur'ak explicitly warns travelers not to seek out Chol'aruk alone. Given its reported enormous size and ferocious bloodlust, taking down the Ravener is intended as a formidable challenge requiring a prepared hunting party.

Quilboar are boar-like humanoids native to the plains of central Kalimdor, with the Razormane tribe inhabiting parts of the Barrens. The Razormane themselves speak of Chol'aruk with dread, giving the beast the title 'The Ravener'.
faq.q: What is the connection between Chol'aruk and the Razormane quilboar?

sections.body: In the arid expanse of the Barrens, whispers among the Razormane quilboar tell of Chol'aruk, an enormous terror dubbed 'The Ravener'. According to regional rumors, this nightmarish brute makes its lair deep in a cavern at Thorn Hill, northeast of the local trails. The quilboar claim it stands roughly five times the size of an ordinary quilboar, driven by a violent, unquenchable thirst for blood. While many dismiss such tales as exaggerated campfire stories, Gur'ak knows better from past battles with similar monstrosities.
sections.title: The Legend of the Ravener

sections.body: Recognizing the genuine danger posed by a beast of such magnitude, Gur'ak directs capable travelers to track the creature to its subterranean lair in Thorn Hill. His instructions are direct: put an end to the monstrous brute and return with its head as undisputed proof. Given Chol'aruk's rumored ferocity and colossal scale, Gur'ak issues a stern caution that only well-prepared groups should dare enter the cave to confront the Ravener.
sections.title: Gur'ak's Warning

summary: Chol'aruk the Ravener is a hunt in the Barrens targeting a colossal quilboar rumored to dwell in a cavern at Thorn Hill. Believing the dire tales after past encounters with similar beasts, the orc Gur'ak tasks adventurers with braving its lair and bringing back its head.
attribution: In-game quest text: Chol'aruk the Ravener
